corrections: Replaced the shared fighter shape with a dedicated single-seat Typhoon: measured pointed radome, hollow canopy, split chin intake, narrow dorsal spine, delta wing, close-coupled canards, single swept fin and two open EJ200 exhausts. No external stores or pylons.

Uniform side, top and front overlays corrected the wing trailing edge and fin root. Close views narrowed the upper engine shoulders, filled a forebody join and conformed access-panel borders to the actual body skin. Added selected flush fasteners, DASS wingtip fairings, PIRATE housing and subdued roundels.

Rebuilt the three equal 6in MHDD housings, offset lower center display, projecting head-up control panel, wide HUD combiner, left keypad, upper-right standby, center stick, twin throttle, pedals, console plates and Mk16A-style seat. Added lower electrical panel, sloping front consoles, ventilation outlets, harness and guarded selectors.

Right-display photo rectification uses BAE dimensions. Checked remaining panel spacing approximately against the distinct tribp photograph and manufacturer in-flight cockpit image. Two other Commons cockpit images were excluded after discovering conflicting photographer credits.

Shared expressions drive true airspeed, geometric altitude, vertical speed, attitude and true heading; missing readings blank and negative altitude retains its sign. Canards, both pairs of elevons, leading slats, swept rudder, gear and pilot controls animate. Imported-node tests verify fixed hinge endpoints and opposite inputs.
independentDimensions: Manufacturer 15.96m overall length and 10.95m span; RAF independently gives 15.96m length and 5.29m height. Final bounds span 10.9498m and extend from z=-6.96 to z=9.0, with a 5.29m fin.

Inductiveload public-domain four-view is an illustrative general arrangement, not an engineering drawing. Its length/span ratios disagree by about 2%; each view uses one uniform scale, published dimensions take precedence and detached wheel cartoons do not define landing gear.

Canopy approximately 4.04m long, 1.02m maximum width and 3.34m top height; canard tip span about 3.88m. These are photo/drawing reconstructions. Wheelbase 4.15m, track 2.34m and tire/retraction details remain approximations.

BAE specifies three existing 6x6in displays: each active area is 0.1524m square. Four-corner rectification of the right display is recorded. Off-axis lens distortion and HUD projection limit calibration to that plane; no precise whole-cockpit dimensions are claimed.
reviewNotes.visual: Personally inspected all 24 final-hash captures in six contact sheets: four exterior/panel overlays, eight standard views and twelve dynamic/detail views. Compared the drawing, manufacturer cockpit/top view, MOD exterior photograph, distinct tribp cockpit photo and MOD canopy photograph. Inspected clean gear-up flight, both control directions, zero/cruise/extreme/missing readings, negative altitude, canopy side, consoles and exhausts.
limitations: Polygonal reconstruction, not an engineering replica. Compound body sections, intake internals, fin fillets, canopy curvature, gear mechanics and exact panel/fastener patterns remain simplified. General-arrangement drawing has scale inconsistencies; the model is not stretched to hide them.

The CC-BY cockpit photograph depicts a static display with unspecified production block. Known MHDD dimensions anchor the main panel. Console depths, switch legends, seat/harness, standby size and HUCP projection are approximations; the full panel cannot be metrically verified from this oblique photograph.

Flight pages are authored Molen simulator displays, not operational Typhoon avionics. TAS, geometric altitude and true heading are labeled accordingly. No calibrated IAS/Mach, pressure altitude, magnetic variation, radar, fuel or engine core gauges are invented. HUD has optical geometry only, without collimated symbology.

Assisted flight physics and control mixes are not Typhoon flight-control laws. Slats use the shared flap command; gear folds approximately and hides when retracted. Canopy, exhaust petals and systems switches are static; no combat functionality or external weapons.

Reference pixels remain local and are not model textures. CC-BY tribp and OGL MOD attribution is recorded. Manufacturer images are local study only. The two conflicting Commons credits remain explicitly excluded from verified open-license evidence.
